verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud platform, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The documented agent integration is a `vastai` agent skill/plugin installed via `npx skills add`, plus the CLI, SDK and REST API. Those are a different integration mechanism and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
